answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks through proof-of-burn registration. Agents provably destroy base tokens into an unspendable sable sink to mint cryptographic credentials. An attacker incurs irreversible capital loss per identity rather than multiplying like a weightless zephyr across virtual hosts. The agent begins its operational voyage anchored to this verifiable sacrifice. However, the mechanism cannot stop well-funded adversaries whose exploit gains exceed cumulative burn costs.
